name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: FRESH-GSMFIELDS-RETRY BUILD (v4): 0.5.2 was reported to still break reading, after the 3rd or 4th message. A production osclientcerts.log showed a full doCleanup()-triggered cert enumeration followed by repeated CERT_FindCertByIssuerAndSN-style lookups (from recreateComposeSecure()'s checkRecipientCerts()) immediately preceding the established CKR_FUNCTION_NOT_SUPPORTED 'reading broke' signature -- on a cycle where doCleanup() apparently found nothing to delete, so cleanupAndReinit()'s reinit was skipped, leaving checkRecipientCerts()'s own NSS-touching disturbance completely unprotected. The failure-handling path in onComposeProcessDone now always reinitializes CertVerifier after doCleanup(), regardless of whether anything was actually deleted that cycle, before recreateComposeSecure() runs -- cleanupAndReinit() itself (still gated) is now only used at shutdown, where nothing follows it.
